dominant_failure_bucket.interpretation: The common failure is a materially nonpositive optimum inside the selected exact phase cell, not a permissive replay guard or floating-point envelope.

complementarity_feasibility_review.network_problem_class: mixed linear complementarity / LPCC with boxed free inputs, arbitrary signed residual weights, and a property objective
complementarity_feasibility_review.reason: The input box, affine equalities, property feasibility condition, and arbitrary signed network operators do not yield one monotone square LCP with a polynomial pivot guarantee.
complementarity_feasibility_review.complete_solution_requirement: A complete method must make combinatorial active-set choices or use a mixed-integer/disjunctive search, which violates the no-BaB and low-latency constraints.
complementarity_feasibility_review.implementation_cost: A new global sparse basis/factorization engine would duplicate backend machinery and operate on thousands of phase variables with million-scale coupling; it is not a compact common-path change.

decision: Do not add a complementarity backend, replay fallback, or native RANGE side path. A future attempt must replace the current cell selector with one compact, genuinely global mechanism whose complexity is bounded before implementation.
